mapper.insert: INSERT INTO template (category_id, name, content_html, draft_content_html, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentHtml}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id, name, content_html, draft_content_html, draft_saved_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM template WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, category_id, name, content_html, draft_content_html, draft_saved_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM template WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY id
